content: Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store the medication bottle upright at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze the product. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Proper storage ensures the medication remains effective and safe for use. Formulary and Plan Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary details, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
